Additional questions concern reception and evaluation of the program 'Umschau', audience interest in particular topics, the influence of shift work on television viewing, knowledge of current television schedules, preferred broadcasting times for a proposed youth program, and parental influence on children's viewing behavior. Explicitly includes household size, age, gender, education, occupation, continuing education, party membership, and other demographic characteristics. Particularly valuable for examining the relationship between work, household circumstances, demographics, and television consumption.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 13. Woche 1985 (SFR 13/85)
justification: Relevant survey from 1985 examining participation in and evaluation of East German television programs. Includes assessments of the suspense, realism, and fulfillment of audience expectations concerning the crime film 'Polizeiruf 110 – Traum des Vergessens'. Additional questions explore interest in cultural programming, preferred cultural subjects, frequency of watching 'Kulturmagazin', preferred broadcast days, occupational demands, physical and mental fatigue after work, and expectations concerning television programming. Particularly useful for connecting audience evaluations of television films with occupational characteristics and viewing preferences.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 14. Woche 1982 (SFR 14/82)
justification: Relevant GESIS survey from 1982 examining East German television audiences through a representative household sample. Includes assessments of the entertainment value and realism of 'Der Staatsanwalt hat das Wort: Hoffnung für Anna', the perceived crime-prevention value of the broadcast, the number of episodes watched of 'Du und dein Haustier', and audience evaluations of the television play 'Der Notnagel'. It also investigates awareness of several television programs, including youth programming and cultural broadcasts. Suitable for analyzing television series, audience engagement, program recognition, and evaluations of fictional television content.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 5. Woche 1985 (SFR 5/85)
justification: Relevant survey from early 1985 examining audience participation and television viewing behavior. Includes reasons for watching 'Auf Schusters Rappen', evaluations of its presenter, interactions with family members while watching television, and assessments of the entertainment value of the film 'Außenseiter'. It also investigates audience familiarity with and suggestions for improving the program 'Stop!'. Particularly useful for studying television hosts, evaluations of films, interpersonal behavior during television viewing, and audience engagement with specific broadcasts.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 35. Woche 1988 (SFR 35/88)
justification: Relevant GESIS dataset from 1988 belonging to the DDR television audience research collection. Investigates television participation and viewing behavior using standardized interviews about programs broadcast during the preceding week. Based on a representative, stratified household sample selected from the television subscriber register maintained by the Deutsche Post. Useful for comparing television viewing patterns and audience evaluations in the late 1980s with earlier surveys in the same research series.

returned_title: Representatives in the Reichstag in the Weimar Republic 1919–1933 (Abgeordnete der Reichstage der Weimarer Republik 1919–1933) — GESIS ZA8007
justification: Excellent match and the most directly relevant dataset for this research need. Compiled by Heinrich Best, this dataset provides collective biographical information on all 1,794 representatives of the Weimar National Assembly and German Reichstag from 1919 through the March 1933 election. It contains 377 variables covering academic titles, education, vocational training, occupations, parliamentary mandates, political functions, positions in state parliaments, migration and emigration, organizational and association memberships, political protest, persecution, and professional career trajectories. Events are accompanied by chronological information, making the dataset particularly valuable for longitudinal analyses of parliamentary elites, political mobility, institutional continuity, and political repression during the Weimar Republic. The information was assembled from biographical dictionaries, parliamentary handbooks, parliamentary proceedings, and archival materials. This dataset closely matches virtually every element of the requested research criteria.

returned_title: The State Parliament Representatives of the Weimar Republic 1918–1933 (Die Landtagsabgeordneten der Weimarer Republik 1918–1933) — GESIS ZA8071
justification: Highly relevant complementary dataset containing collective biographies of 5,349 representatives serving in German state parliaments during the Weimar Republic, excluding Bremen and Lübeck. Compiled by Martina Zech, Wilhelm H. Schröder, and Wilhelm Weege, the dataset supports comparative analysis of parliamentary elites across German states between 1918 and 1933. Its variables address social backgrounds, recruitment into parliamentary office, occupational histories, political career trajectories, institutional connections, gender, regional differences, parliamentary tenure, party affiliations, and political continuity and discontinuity. Particularly useful for investigating legislators who moved between regional and national politics, reconstructing political career pathways, and examining the relationship between state parliamentary experience and national political leadership.

returned_title: Database of German Parliamentary Representatives 1867–1938 (Datenbank der Deutschen Parlamentsabgeordneten) — Bavarian State Library
justification: Highly relevant historical biographical database maintained by the Bavarian State Library. It contains 5,211 individual records derived from parliamentary almanacs and official Reichstag handbooks covering 1867–1938, including the entire Weimar Republic. Information includes standardized names, dates and places of birth, gender, political party affiliations, electoral districts, religious denominations, occupations, places of residence and employment, biographical summaries, and portraits. Records also document changes between legislative periods, allowing researchers to trace political affiliations and parliamentary careers over time. The database provides connections to parliamentary speeches and historical parliamentary proceedings. It is particularly useful for identifying individual legislators, verifying biographical information, and reconstructing political careers spanning the German Empire, Weimar Republic, and early National Socialist period.

returned_title: Members of the Reichstag in the German Empire 1867/71–1918 (Abgeordnete der Reichstage des Kaiserreichs 1867/71–1918) — GESIS ZA8006
justification: Strong supplementary dataset for investigating the backgrounds and earlier careers of parliamentary elites active during the Weimar Republic. Compiled by Heinrich Best, it provides collective biographical information about Reichstag representatives from the German Empire between 1867 and 1918. Variables include education, vocational training, occupations, parliamentary mandates, political functions, positions in state parliaments, migration, organizational memberships, political protest, persecution, and professional career histories. Its methodological similarities to GESIS ZA8007 make it especially valuable for comparing parliamentary elite structures before and after the democratic transition of 1918–1919. Researchers can use the two datasets to investigate continuity in political leadership, occupational recruitment, organizational connections, and the career trajectories of politicians who served across both regimes. Its main limitation is that its direct coverage ends in 1918.

returned_title: Social Democratic Parliamentarians in German Reich and State Parliaments — GESIS Historical Social Research Database
justification: Relevant specialized collective-biographical research resource focusing on Social Democratic parliamentarians in German national and state legislatures. The GESIS Historical Social Research resource provides access to an accompanying Microsoft Access database developed to investigate the biographies, occupational histories, political career patterns, and parliamentary group structures of Social Democratic legislators. It is particularly useful for studying recruitment into parliamentary politics, relationships between professional and political careers, and the structure of Social Democratic parliamentary elites. The material can support investigations of legislators associated with one of the central political movements of the Weimar Republic. Its narrower partisan focus makes it a complement to, rather than a substitute for, the comprehensive GESIS ZA8007 dataset.

returned_title: German Weimar Republic Data, 1919–1933 — ICPSR Study 42
justification: Useful contextual dataset covering electoral and demographic conditions in Germany during the Weimar Republic from 1919 to 1933. Distributed by the Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research, it includes Reichstag election results, presidential election returns, referendum results, and demographic information at multiple geographic levels, including districts, states, and electoral constituencies. It also contains occupational, religious, and population information derived from historical census records. Although it does not provide the detailed individual biographies, persecution histories, or organizational memberships requested, it is valuable for contextualizing parliamentary elite recruitment, analyzing geographic patterns of political representation, and connecting legislators' career trajectories to electoral and socioeconomic developments. It can be combined with individual-level parliamentary biographical datasets for multilevel historical analysis.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Hörstandort April 1987 – Zusatz: Berliner Rundfunk am Sonntag (ZA6536)
justification: Highly relevant survey dataset from April 1987, conducted by the State Broadcasting Committee of the German Democratic Republic (GDR). It examines radio audience participation and listening locations, with a special focus on Berliner Rundfunk's Sunday programming. Particularly useful for studying Berlin-related broadcasting, station preferences, and listening behavior during the 1980s. It belongs to the GESIS collection 'Radiohören in der DDR (1980–1989)'. The dataset is a strong candidate for investigating regional broadcasting preferences, although coverage of the specific program 'Berliner Luft' should be verified in the questionnaire and codebook.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Paralleltätigkeit Februar 1982 – Zusatz: Radiohören am Wochenende (ZA6503)
justification: Highly relevant survey conducted on February 14, 1982, with 1,987 respondents aged 15 and older across the GDR. Contains 184 variables measuring radio listening on the previous day, station selection, listening times, weekend listening frequency, preferred radio programs, musical preferences, and reasons for listening. It also investigates listening frequency for specific broadcasts. Demographic variables include age, gender, number of children, settlement size, district, education, vocational qualifications, employment, and shift work. Particularly valuable for examining listening frequency, regional differences, station preferences, and demographic characteristics. Berlin-specific analysis may be possible through geographic variables.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Hörstandort Mai 1987 – Zusatz: Jugendradio DT 64 (ZA6537)
justification: GDR radio audience survey conducted in May 1987, focusing on listening participation, listening locations, and the youth-oriented broadcaster DT64. Useful for comparing audience behavior across radio stations and investigating the role of Berlin-associated broadcasting in the late 1980s. The survey covers individuals aged 15 and older and belongs to the same GESIS historical radio listening collection. It provides a potentially useful comparison dataset for station choice and listening habits, although its coverage of 'Berliner Luft' is not confirmed.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Gesellungsform April 1985 – Zusatz: Radiohören am Werktagabend (ZA6522)
justification: Relevant 1985 GDR radio audience survey examining listening participation, social listening contexts, and weekday evening radio consumption. The linked GESIS documentation identifies radio station categories, including Stimme der DDR and regional broadcasters of Radio DDR. Particularly useful for investigating station choice, listening schedules, regional broadcasters, and listening behavior in the middle of the 1980s. The documentation can help determine whether geographic and demographic variables support Berlin-specific comparisons. Coverage of audience evaluations of 'Berliner Luft' is not established.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 47.2: Women and Cancer, the European Parliament, and Expectations of the European Union, April–June 1997
justification: Excellent match for both major research objectives. This survey examines European citizens' attitudes toward the EU, perceptions of European integration, opinions about the European Parliament, and expectations of EU membership. Its women's health component investigates breast and cervical cancer awareness, perceived personal cancer risk, knowledge of screening programs, willingness to participate in screening, and cancer-related information needs. Includes demographic variables such as age, sex, marital status, household income, political orientation, and region. Conducted in 1997 across the 15 EU member states, including Austria, Sweden, and Finland, with coverage of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 49: Food Product Safety, Child Sex Tourism, Health Care, and Cancer, April–May 1998
justification: Excellent match for research on women's breast cancer screening behavior, cancer-related knowledge, preventive health beliefs, and attitudes toward medical screening. Questions address recognition of cancer symptoms, opinions about cancer prevention, and the importance of national breast cancer screening programs. Separate questions were administered to women concerning breast cancer. The survey also includes standard measures of EU awareness, European integration, and political attitudes. Demographic information covers age, sex, marital status, occupation, income, voting intentions, and geographical region. Data were collected in 1998 across all 15 EU member states.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 43.0: March–April 1995
justification: Highly relevant historical dataset combining European public opinion with questions about breast cancer screening. Its women's health questions include awareness of national breast cancer screening programs and beliefs about regular participation in screening. The survey also provides political and social attitude measures useful for examining European integration and EU-related opinions. Particularly valuable for establishing an earlier baseline against which the 1997 and 1998 cancer-awareness surveys can be compared. Conducted in 1995, when the EU included all 15 countries specified in the research request.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 44.2bis Mega-Survey: Policies and Practices in Building Europe and the European Union, January–March 1996
justification: Excellent match for European political attitudes, EU knowledge, institutional perceptions, and European integration. Respondents reported their knowledge of the EU, information sources, perceived benefits of membership, and interest in European affairs. Questions also address preferences concerning European citizenship, common policies, European government, monetary integration, and the future of the EU. Especially valuable because of its unusually large national samples and coverage of all 15 EU member states, with separate samples for Great Britain, Northern Ireland, East Germany, and West Germany. The survey does not focus on breast cancer but provides extensive political and demographic variables for comparative analysis.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 45.1: European Union Rights, Sun Exposure, Work Safety, and Privacy Issues, April–May 1996
justification: Strong match for the EU civil rights component of the research. Investigates citizens' awareness of and attitudes toward rights associated with EU membership, including freedom to travel, work, study, purchase goods, invest, vote, and receive medical care across member states. Also includes standard European public opinion questions and health-related topics. Particularly useful for measuring knowledge of EU citizenship rights and examining how awareness varies across demographic groups and countries during the 1990s.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 56: Citizens First, January–February 1997
justification: Direct match for research on European citizens' knowledge of EU civil rights and their sources of information. Examines awareness of rights concerning employment, university attendance, and residence in other EU countries. Also investigates exposure to information campaigns, communication channels, knowledge of the European Commission and European Parliament's Citizens of Europe initiative, and demand for further information about EU citizenship rights. Includes party preference, age, sex, education, occupation, and geographical characteristics. Conducted in 1997 across 12 EU member states, making it useful for a subset of the requested countries.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 47.2OVR: Young Europeans, April–June 1997
justification: Relevant for studying European identity, social attitudes, political orientations, and knowledge of EU civil rights among young Europeans. Investigates the personal significance of the EU, expected changes resulting from European integration, sources of information about EU citizenship rights, attitudes toward other nationalities, and social and cultural behavior. Covers individuals aged 15–24 across all 15 EU member states in 1997, including separate sampling arrangements for Northern Ireland. Contains 9,818 observations and 397 variables. Particularly useful for comparing younger citizens' political and social attitudes with those of the general adult population.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 33: Spring 1990
justification: Useful for establishing an early-1990s baseline of attitudes toward European integration and European institutions. Covers support for European unification, perceived advantages of European Community membership, political interest, European versus national identity, preferences for European-level policymaking, knowledge of the European Commission, and sources of information about European affairs. Also examines social attitudes and perceptions of European lifestyles and values. Because the survey predates the 1995 EU enlargement, Austria, Finland, and Sweden are not included as EU member-state samples. Best suited to longitudinal comparisons of European political attitudes.

returned_title: Situation of Medium-Sized Companies in North Rhine-Westphalia (1965) – ZA0106
justification: Highly relevant dataset examining the economic situation and organizational structure of medium-sized businesses in North Rhine-Westphalia during the 1960s. Conducted by INTERMARKET Düsseldorf between January and March 1965, the study surveyed 350 businesses across seven economic sectors using standardized interviews. It provides a valuable foundation for investigating business structures, occupational characteristics, and the adaptation of smaller enterprises to industrial society. Its geographic and chronological coverage closely matches the research requirements. However, the available description does not establish whether shoemakers were included in the sample.

returned_title: Attitudes of Self-Employed Craftsmen Toward Credit (1965) – ZA0144
justification: Particularly relevant for understanding the economic behavior and modernization of independent craftsmen during the 1960s. Conducted in October–November 1965 by the Institute for Small Business Research in Cologne, this survey covers 1,204 registered craft businesses in West Germany, potentially including businesses in North Rhine-Westphalia. Topics include business finances, borrowing practices, access to credit, willingness to invest, attitudes toward innovation, business organization, and economic values. The dataset is especially useful for examining how traditional craftsmen responded to financial pressures and opportunities associated with advanced industrial society. Its coverage is nationwide rather than exclusively regional, and the inclusion of shoemakers requires verification.

returned_title: Employed Persons by Economic Sector in the Territory of Today's North Rhine-Westphalia, 1850–1970 – ZA8685
justification: Historical employment dataset providing regional economic and occupational statistics for North Rhine-Westphalia through 1970. It contains 3,934 time series covering cities, districts, and their historical predecessors. Particularly valuable for examining changes in employment patterns, economic sectors, and the transition from traditional trades toward industrial employment. The data can help contextualize the decline or transformation of independent craft businesses during the 1960s. Although it does not directly measure shoemakers' attitudes, guild membership, or family labor, it provides essential historical employment and demographic context.

returned_title: Tax Climate in 1960 – ZA0020
justification: Relevant regional survey conducted in July 1960 among 556 business owners in Dortmund, Cologne, and Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia. It investigates business owners' attitudes toward tax authorities, tax audits, payment deferrals, and administrative decision-making. The dataset can support research into the financial environment, institutional relationships, and economic attitudes of independent business proprietors. Although the surveyed population consists of shop owners belonging to the Federation of Taxpayers rather than specifically shoemakers, it provides useful evidence about the experiences of self-employed entrepreneurs in the region.

returned_title: Socioeconomic, Political and Fiscal Data for German Federal States, 1960 and 1970 – ZA0920
justification: Relevant contextual dataset containing socioeconomic, demographic, political, and fiscal indicators for German federal states in 1960 and 1970, including North Rhine-Westphalia. It can support analysis of the wider economic and political environment in which independent craftsmen operated. Particularly useful for relating changes in craft employment and business organization to broader demographic developments, economic modernization, and political conditions. The data are aggregated at the federal-state level and therefore cannot directly identify shoemakers, guild members, or individual political attitudes.

returned_title: Regional Census Data 1961: German Federal States – ZA1827
justification: Relevant historical census dataset providing population and employment statistics for German federal states, including North Rhine-Westphalia, based on the 1961 census. It covers demographic characteristics, family structures, population development, and economic activity. These indicators can help establish the social and demographic background of craftsmen during the early 1960s. Particularly useful for contextualizing occupational participation, household structures, and the demographic characteristics of the workforce. It does not directly provide detailed information about individual shoemaking businesses.

returned_title: Regional Census Data 1970: German Federal States – ZA1740
justification: Historical census dataset providing population, employment, and demographic statistics for North Rhine-Westphalia and other German federal states in 1970, with historical population figures extending back to 1939, 1950, and 1961. Useful for assessing demographic and employment changes across the 1960s and examining the broader transition toward advanced industrial society. When combined with the 1961 census dataset, it enables comparisons of occupational and demographic structures before and after the decade. Its aggregate nature limits direct analysis of individual craftsmen or shoemaking establishments.

returned_title: Industrial Relations in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1950–1999 – ZA8450
justification: Historical dataset documenting developments in industrial relations, employment, trade unions, employer associations, collective bargaining, workplace representation, and labor conflicts between 1950 and 1999. It provides useful information for studying the institutional and labor-market changes affecting traditional craftsmen during the industrial transformation of the 1960s. Particularly relevant for contextualizing professional organization, collective representation, and the changing social position of independent tradespeople. However, it does not specifically measure membership in shoemakers' guilds or individual craftsmen's political attitudes.

returned_title: Basic Economic Data for Germany, 1950–1997: National Accounts, Industry, Prices, Wages, Public Finances and Social Security – ZA8406
justification: Comprehensive historical economic dataset covering industrial production, employment, wages, productivity, domestic and international trade, and economic development during the 1960s. It is useful for examining the broader economic conditions that influenced traditional craft businesses, including industrial expansion, changing labor markets, and competitive pressures. The dataset can provide macroeconomic context for analyzing mechanization and craftsmen's adaptation to industrial society. Its principal limitation is its national rather than North Rhine-Westphalia-specific coverage.

returned_title: German Health Update 2009 (GEDA 2009) – Scientific Use File
justification: Highly relevant population-based health survey conducted by the Robert Koch Institute (RKI) between July 2008 and May 2009, covering 21,262 adults aged 18 and older. Includes information on health behaviors, smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity, preventive healthcare, vaccination, chronic diseases, and sociodemographic characteristics. Particularly useful for investigating adult preventive health practices and cardiovascular risk factors during the late 2000s. Rhineland-Palatinate observations are included in the nationwide sample. Federal-state identification requires extended data access because the standard Scientific Use File provides broader Nielsen regions.

returned_title: German Health Update 2010 (GEDA 2010) – Scientific Use File
justification: Nationally representative adult health interview survey conducted between September 2009 and July 2010, involving 22,050 participants. Provides detailed information about preventive healthcare, vaccination, screening participation, smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity, chronic health conditions, healthcare utilization, and socioeconomic characteristics. Suitable for examining relationships between preventive behaviors, cardiovascular risk factors, and population characteristics. Rhineland-Palatinate-specific analyses are possible through extended access to federal-state identifiers.

returned_title: German Health Update 2012 (GEDA 2012) – Scientific Use File
justification: Population-representative health survey conducted from March 2012 to March 2013, including 19,294 adults and 279 variables. Covers self-reported health, health behaviors, chronic diseases, preventive service utilization, and sociodemographic factors. Relevant for analyzing smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity, and preventive healthcare practices in relation to cardiovascular and cancer risk factors. Rhineland-Palatinate can be identified through extended research access. Combining this dataset with GEDA 2009 and GEDA 2010 may improve the statistical precision of regional analyses.

returned_title: German Health Update 2014/2015 – European Health Interview Survey (GEDA 2014/2015-EHIS)
justification: One of the strongest matches for the research need. Conducted between November 2014 and July 2015, the survey includes 24,016 adults and 269 variables. It provides information on preventive screenings, healthcare utilization, prescribed and nonprescribed medication, smoking, alcohol consumption, dietary habits, physical activity, and sociodemographic characteristics. It also includes information relevant to cardiovascular health and chronic medical conditions. Unlike earlier GEDA Scientific Use Files, this dataset includes federal-state identifiers, enabling direct investigation of respondents living in Rhineland-Palatinate. Direct measures of perceived cardiovascular or cancer risk and blood pressure knowledge should be verified against the questionnaire.

returned_title: German Health Update 2019/2020 – European Health Interview Survey (GEDA 2019/2020-EHIS)
justification: Highly relevant for examining adult health behaviors and preventive healthcare at the end of the 2010s. Data collection began in April 2019, and the Scientific Use File covers 22,708 respondents with 310 variables. Includes health behaviors, healthcare utilization, chronic health conditions, and sociodemographic characteristics. Particularly valuable for comparing smoking, alcohol consumption, diet, physical activity, and preventive healthcare indicators with earlier GEDA waves. Federal-state identifiers are available in the Scientific Use File, supporting Rhineland-Palatinate-specific analysis. Because data collection extends into 2020, the dataset is not restricted entirely to the 2010s.

returned_title: German Health Interview and Examination Survey for Adults (DEGS1), 2008–2011
justification: Major nationwide adult health examination and interview dataset conducted by the Robert Koch Institute between 2008 and 2011, involving approximately 7,987 adults aged 18–79. Particularly useful for research involving cardiovascular risk factors, blood pressure, chronic diseases, medication use, preventive screening, smoking, alcohol consumption, diet, physical activity, and socioeconomic status. Its combination of interviews and physical examinations offers advantages over purely self-reported health surveys. The dataset includes respondents from across Germany, but the availability and suitability of Rhineland-Palatinate-specific geographic identifiers require confirmation with the RKI Research Data Centre. Direct measures of risk perception and blood pressure knowledge are not established.

returned_title: RKI Research Data Centre – Population Health Survey Scientific Use Files
justification: Official landing page for the Robert Koch Institute's GEDA survey datasets, providing access information, variable documentation, survey periods, sample sizes, and geographic resolution. Especially important for researchers studying Rhineland-Palatinate because the 2009, 2010, and 2012 standard Scientific Use Files identify broader geographic regions, while federal-state identifiers require extended access. The 2014/2015 and 2019/2020 Scientific Use Files provide federal-state identifiers. Researchers can use this resource to identify suitable variables for adult vaccination status, preventive screenings, medication and treatment, chronic diseases, and health behaviors before requesting individual-level data.

returned_title: Statistical Office of Rhineland-Palatinate – Regional Health Reporting (Gesundheitsberichterstattung)
justification: Official regional health statistics portal covering Rhineland-Palatinate. Provides health reporting indicators that can complement population survey microdata, particularly for regional healthcare utilization, disease burden, preventive services, and population health trends. Relevant for establishing the geographic and epidemiological context of adult health during the 2000s and 2010s. It is particularly useful for comparing regional health outcomes with findings from GEDA and DEGS. However, these are primarily aggregated health statistics rather than individual-level survey responses, and detailed information on perceived disease risk, dietary habits, or blood pressure knowledge may not be available.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968–1980), IS I – 1970 (3rd Wave)
justification: Highly relevant longitudinal survey conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig. Examines personality development and social behavior among East German adolescents. The broader study covers school performance, occupational aspirations, friendships, political orientations, socialist identification, media consumption, youth organizations, and family background. This 1970 wave provides an early observation of adolescent development during the target decade and can be linked conceptually to subsequent waves.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968–1980), IS I – 1975 (8th Wave)
justification: Excellent match for the research requirements. This 1975 survey examines personality development, social relationships, occupational aspirations, vocational training, satisfaction with educational and employment choices, political ideology, media use, family life, and youth development. Conducted among students and apprentices in Leipzig, it includes 720 respondents and 134 variables. Particularly useful for investigating how educational experiences, employment expectations, political socialization, and social environments shaped young people in the GDR.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968–1980), IS I – 1977 (10th Wave)
justification: One of the strongest matches. The 1977 wave covers employment satisfaction, educational experiences, newspaper readership, East and West German television and radio consumption, political information, socialist attitudes, and identification with the GDR. It also investigates friendship networks, FDJ membership and participation, relationships with parents, political discussions within families, perceived parental influence, health status, physical complaints, smoking behavior, and educational qualifications. Particularly valuable for examining connections between personality development, political socialization, media exposure, family relationships, and health behaviors.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968–1980), IS I – 1980 (12th Wave, Cross-Section)
justification: Closely related follow-up dataset documenting the development of the cohort originally surveyed during the 1960s and 1970s. Although collected in 1980, it provides valuable information about educational trajectories and experiences during the preceding decade. Variables include occupational satisfaction, employment histories, school qualifications, political information, mass-media consumption, FDJ participation, identification with socialism, political attitudes, family formation, and personal life goals. Useful for studying longer-term outcomes of adolescent socialization in the 1970s.

returned_title: Leisure Activities Among Schoolchildren 1977 (Freizeitgestaltung bei Schülern 1977)
justification: Strong supplementary dataset for cultural activities, friendship networks, educational performance, political attitudes, and participation in socialist youth organizations. The survey examines leisure interests, relationships within school classes, informal peer groups, self-assessed academic achievement, participation in FDJ activities, political education, attitudes toward Marxism-Leninism, and identification with the GDR. It also includes music, literature, film preferences, cultural participation, sports activities, and leisure-related consumer behavior. Particularly useful for analyzing the relationship between cultural participation, peer relationships, school experiences, and political socialization among East German adolescents.

returned_title: Schoolchildren Interval Study IS II (Older Cohort), 1979–1985, 1st Wave (1979)
justification: Highly relevant longitudinal dataset beginning in 1979 and examining personality development, social behavior, education, and occupational development among East German adolescents. Topics include political interest, identification with Marxism-Leninism, attitudes toward the socialist state, opinions about West Germany, parental influence, participation in the FDJ and other organizations, political activities, and consumption of East and West German television and radio. Particularly valuable for studying political socialization, family influences, media exposure, and youth organization participation at the end of the 1970s.

returned_title: Student Interval Study 1970–1985, SIS 2 (1971)
justification: Relevant supplementary longitudinal survey of East German university and college students. Conducted in May 1971, it includes 1,949 respondents and 360 variables. The study investigates personality development, political and ideological attitudes, educational expectations, academic motivation, relationships with teachers, integration into student groups, perceptions of personal achievement, and attitudes toward Marxism-Leninism. It provides evidence about the political and social development of older youth pursuing higher education, although it is less directly focused on school-age adolescents and parental assessments.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968–1980), IS I – 1969 (2nd Wave)
justification: Important baseline dataset for understanding adolescent development during the 1970s. Although collected in 1969, it belongs to the same longitudinal research program and contains 954 respondents and 89 variables. Topics closely match the requested variables: newspaper readership, East and West German broadcasting, occupational aspirations, school performance, friendship networks, peer-group relationships, Pioneer organization participation, willingness to join the FDJ, headaches, nausea, insomnia, political attitudes, socialist identification, cultural interests, and parental occupations. Particularly useful as an earlier observation for analyzing subsequent changes in the cohort throughout the 1970s.
